reasons: Cited Sections 11.1–11.3 substantively satisfy the rule's preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance on Customer's request, return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification.
Rationale is accurate to the text, including the favorable extras (rates fixed at expiring Order Form, no withholding for fee disputes, deletion only after Customer confirms successful return).
Consistent with a compliant finding: no redline or counterparty comment proposed, and the deterministic check confirms transition/data-return language is present.
